claim_text: Architected a governed agentic systems architecture establishing a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows across regulated financial-services engagements.
Built consumption and renewal signal instrumentation for enterprise AI platform adoption, aligning adoption motions to partner revenue and deal-support priorities.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through context engineering and runtime resilience controls spanning evaluation gates and rollback paths.
Standardized managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design, compressing the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks for production deployments.
Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design.
Converted bespoke delivery into commercialized platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28.
